fields.why: The Table gives each outcome for five race/ethnicity groups side by side, which meets 'three or more group values shown' even though the text does not rank them. A recorded age and education side by side but left out race.

The weights are raked to Census totals by race/ethnicity and educational attainment alike, so education gets a weighting-variable covariate role just as race does. B gave race that role but left out SES.

brief_issues: The roles list has no 'weighting' role; readers map weighting variables to 'covariate' (level-1 text). An explicit rule would stop readers applying it inconsistently.
